cohort: The study participants were women in Ghana who contributed data to the 2007 Ghana Maternal Health Survey, reflecting maternal health care utilisation in the five years preceding the survey.
finding: Minority ethnic groups in Ghana reported significantly lower utilisation levels for most components of skilled maternity care, including institutional delivery, skilled birth attendance, and post-natal care, compared to majority ethnic groups.
mod_finding: Significant ethnic disparities were found in the utilisation of institutional delivery, skilled birth attendance, and caesarean section, with minority groups having lower rates.
